article: Cargo-Lite 2.0 was released on Tuesday with a shared build cache keyed by content hash. One company reported clean builds dropping from 41 minutes to 6. The old configuration format is removed in 3.0; a migration command rewrites it.

summary.headline: Cargo-Lite 2.0 ships a shared build cache
bullets: Clean builds dropped from 41 to 6 minutes at one company.
The old configuration format is removed in 3.0.
summary.why_it_matters: Why it matters: faster Rust builds.
